content:
Jake (Support): Heads-up — Zenfold onboarding hit an availability blocker with SSO provisioning, customer reports an error when uploading IdP metadata. Marking P1 for CS handoff.

TriageBot: Incident created: INC-20240322-789; severity: P1; assigned: support.

Jake (Support): Error payload from logs: `403 Forbidden` when POST /saml/metadata. Repro steps: 1) upload metadata XML, 2) UI returns 500, 3) backend logs show `saml: invalid-entity: missing-cert`.

Maria (CS): Copy — important context: Zenfold is on a trial with an annual renewal due 2026-06. If we can't get them live within 3 business days this becomes a renewal-risk. @Raj (AE) fyi.

Raj (AE): Thanks. Customer needs a working demo on Tues for their leadership. Can we do a temporary manual provisioning if upload is blocked? I'll prepare a renewal mitigation note.

Sophie (Onboarding): I can run a SAML metadata sanity check and attempt manual provisioning. Please DM the metadata XML and IdP EntityID. ETA: 4 hours for initial test in staging.

Jake (Support): Sent DM with metadata file and customer report. Additional note: UI upload fails when file > 12KB — hits a size limit and returns a 500.

Maria (CS): Draft comms plan — short and actionable:
- Immediate (0-4h): Sophie attempts manual provisioning + sanity check (owner: Sophie). If successful, confirm demo path.
- Short (24h): Support/product to create a ticket for UI size-limit bug and triage priority (owner: Jake / Eng-Frontend).
- Medium (72h): Exec touchpoint + renewal mitigation email to Zenfold leadership (owner: Raj).
I'll draft the email and post for review. :white_check_mark:

Sophie (Onboarding): Manual provisioning in progress. If I can import the metadata via admin API, we'll enable SSO and share temp access links. Posting results in ~2-3h.

Raj (AE): Please cc me on the exec note. I'll loop in RevOps with the mitigation plan so renewal isn't auto-flagged.

Maria (CS): Thanks — I'll log renewal-risk in Gainsight and attach the incident ID. Will post the email draft in this thread once ready.
